title: Ruin Hold
summary: A first-person co-op hold on the forge runtime: two waves of the risen dead and their captain in a moonlit ruin, with down and revive. Free stand-in art (KayKit and Quaternius, CC0). WebGPU, else WebGL2; desktop and phone.

verified.result: PASS gates 6/6, measures 23/23, none skipped; the same with the free stand-ins alone (XGAMES_PRIVATE_PACKS pointing at an empty folder) and with this machine's private art
verified.how: node bin/gamesfun.mjs create <dir> --from ruin-hold, then node builder/tools/verify.mjs <dir> (a build verify, every build measure; about 7 minutes) under gpu-run.sh on Linux with a desktop GPU (WebGPU, its WebGL2 build for measure 32)
